current.thesis: MCX Crude will break below ₹7,610 by MCX close today as the risk-off sentiment that drove the overnight 5.56% rout remains intact with no structural support visible.
current.reasoning: ₹7,610 is the only identified support level and the day's low; with the 20-SMA at ₹8,583 now 12.5% above price and no intermediate resistance named, a break below this level signals capitulation in the crude selloff.
